zh-CN.title: 查看权限与额度
items: 菜单新增「权限与额度」，集中查看语音通话、外部链接解析、广场发言与评论、云端资源等用量，以及媒体消息、群聊和科研权限。

en.title: Permissions and quotas at a glance
items: Open Permissions & quotas in Menu to see voice call time, external link parsing, Square posting and comments, cloud storage, and your permissions for media messages, groups, and Research.
